column1: Missing authorization check leading to successful deletion of another user's article on the "Delete an article" endpoint.
column26:
*Steps to reproduce:*

# Go to "[+Conduit+|https://conduit.mate.academy/]"
# Register two different users
# As User A, create an article and save its slug
# As User B, go to Postman and send a "Delete an article" request using User A's slug but User B's token.
# Observe the status code and the state of the article.

*Expected result:* The server should return a 403 Forbidden status and prevent the deletion of an article by a non-owner user.

*Actual result:* The server returns a 204 No Content status and successfully deletes the article belonging to another user.

column1: Inconsistent response format for 401 Unauthorized error on the "Create an article" endpoint.
column26:
*Steps to reproduce:*

# Go to "[Conduit|https://conduit.mate.academy/]".
# Go to Postman and try to send a "Create an article" request without providing a token in the headers.
# Observe the response format.

*Expected result:* The server returns a status code 401 Unauthorized and a JSON object with an error message for consistency with other API endpoints.

*Actual result:* The server returns a status code 401 Unauthorized, but the response body contains only Plain Text "Unauthorized", which causes parsing errors in automated tests and frontend applications.

*Attachments:* [link|https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=1k5mDORgBKv1zD_gCFuazZc3-KgoBadGk&authuser=0]

column1: Missing "Username" length validation in Registration API
column26:
*Steps to reproduce:*

# Open Postman
# Send a POST request to the /api/users endpoint.
# In the request body, provide a "Username" containing 41 symbols
# Fill other required fields ("Email", "Password") with valid, unique data.
# [Send] the request and observe the response.

*Expected result:* User is not registered, validation error "is too long (maximum is 40 characters)" is shown, status code 422.

*Actual result:* User is registered, status code 201 Created is returned despite 41 symbols in the "Username" field.

*Attachments*: [link|https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=1uA3PpcHmfa2zTM7ncrlveD6DvUC1W5gw&authuser=0]
